title: (0Day) D-Link DAP-3662 httpd Authentication Bypass Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DAP-3662 Wi-Fi access points. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the httpd web server. A crafted HTTP request can bypass the authentication mechanism. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
